steps.details: Executed 203 web unit tests, 90 shared warehouse tests, and api route tests. Baseline established.

Added missing POST /api/inventory/:organizationId/overdraft-alert endpoint in apps/api/src/routes/inventory.ts. Soft overdraft during visits logs into inventoryTransactions with transactionType emergency_overdraft and isOverdraft: true without 500 crashes or doctor checkout blocks.

Aligned overdraft badge condition in InventoryBatchFefoPanel.tsx (qty <= 0) with WarehouseItemsTable.tsx. Added intelligent expired item routing in InventoryView.tsx: anesthetics/carpules -> NurseCarpuleDisposalModal, general materials -> 1-click ClinicalWriteoffModal.

Integrated POST /api/inventory/:organizationId/acceptance-waybill into InventoryInboundInvoiceModal.tsx for industrial waybill ingestion with lot number, FEFO expiry date, unit price, and automatic overdraft clearance. Added fallback loop and created POST /:organizationId/items alias in backend.

Wired onConfirmTransfer in WarehouseTransferModal inside InventoryExternalModals.tsx to dispatch server deduction with allowOverdraft: true. Fixed import React in ClinicalWriteoffQuickStrip.tsx. Fixed isDatabaseUnavailable in fixtureOrganizations.ts to inspect nested error.cause.

Created warehouseInboundOverdraftInquisitor.test.ts (5/5 pass). Full inventory suite: 203/203 pass (0 fails). Shared warehouse suite: 90/90 pass (0 fails). TypeScript check in api clean (0 errors), web warehouse components clean (0 errors).

findings: Defect 1 Fixed: Missing POST /:orgId/overdraft-alert causing background 404s during doctor auto-deduction overdrafts.

Defect 2 Fixed: Inbound invoice modal called POST /:organizationId/items which was missing (now aliased in Fastify routes) and omitted FEFO lots on stock update; upgraded to atomic acceptance-waybill ingestion.
Defect 3 Fixed: Missing onConfirmTransfer handler in InventoryExternalModals for WarehouseTransferModal; now deducts dispatched items with allowOverdraft: true.
Defect 4 Fixed: Overdraft badge inconsistency between WarehouseItemsTable (qty <= 0) and InventoryBatchFefoPanel (qty < 0).
Defect 5 Fixed: InventoryView previously routed ALL expired materials to nurse carpule modal; now intelligently distinguishes anesthetics vs general consumables.
Defect 6 Fixed: isDatabaseUnavailable helper in fixtureOrganizations.ts failed to check error.cause on Drizzle wrapped connection errors, leading to false negatives when postgres was offline.
Defect 7 Fixed: React type import in ClinicalWriteoffQuickStrip.tsx causing potential JSX runtime reference error.
